comment: Golden corpus for the parse eval. home_id + manual_id address a v2 Firestore manual; the runner resolves its PDF from Firebase Storage (read-only) and caches it under .pdf-cache/. model mirrors pickParseModel (gas/safety-critical items escalate to Opus).
corpus_notes: Rebuilt 2026-07-30. The original corpus addressed v1 Supabase manual_document rows; that project was DELETED, so every PDF fetch failed and this harness was un-runnable — which is why the prompt-curation PR (#2) stalled.

LOST to the migration (sourceRef still points at the dead Supabase host, PDFs unrecoverable): range-ge-gas (27bf5e43), microwave-drawer (9a053574), and the Bosch dishwasher — the appliance whose 'Add Detergent Before Each Cycle' triggered this work. Their golden snapshots stay in golden/ for reference but can no longer be reproduced.
COVERAGE GAP from that loss: no gas/combustion manual survives, so pickParseModel's Opus escalation path is no longer exercised. Add a gas manual to the corpus when one is re-uploaded.
washer-lg and foodcycler carry over from the original corpus (their PDFs survived as Storage uploads), so those goldens remain comparable across the v1->v2 move.

manuals.name: nespresso-vertuo
manuals.note: THE trigger case — this manual produced 'Replace Water in the Tank' as an Essential task. Operational top-ups must become tips, not tasks.

manuals.name: foodcycler
manuals.note: Tier-inflation case: prior golden had 10 tasks / 6 habits / 50% essential, over the harness's own 40% warning. 'Replace Carbon Filters' MUST survive.

manuals.name: dryer-lg
manuals.note: Both-directions case: lint-trap/vent work is real safety maintenance that must NOT be demoted, while 'Clean door window and seal' is cleaning noise.

manuals.name: furnace-york
manuals.note: Must-not-lose case: filter replacement is the canonical real maintenance task; curation must never drop it.

manuals.name: washer-lg
manuals.note: Large-appliance manual (english-only upload). Carried over from the original corpus.
